headlines.title: GM Q3 Deep Dive: New Truck Launches, Cost Pressures, and Digital Revenue Strategy
headlines.summary: Automotive manufacturer General Motors (NYSE:GM) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 2.9% year on year to $50.02 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.70 per share was 1.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: General Motors narrows 2026 EBIT guidance, approves $20bn share repurchase
headlines.summary: Net income attributable to stockholders rose to $3.33bn from $1.32bn a year earlier, while EBIT-adjusted increased 21.6% year-on-year to $4.10bn.

headlines.title: GM shares are on sale for investors willing to buy into weakness, analyst says
headlines.summary: GM shares are down big, despite beating analysts’ top- and bottom-line estimates.

headlines.title: General Motors (GM) Stock Price Slides As Q3 Earnings Meet Leverage Fears
headlines.summary: The market punished General Motors on Tuesday. The stock dropped 6.8% to about US$77 by the close, even as the automaker posted record Q3 2026 revenue of US$50b and adjusted earnings per share of US$3.70. Traders focused on fear. The mood reflected worries about costs and leverage, while the printed numbers showed robust earnings power and US$4.1b in adjusted earnings before interest and taxes for the quarter.

headlines.title: Wall Street applauds GM stock buyback plan. The UAW is far from happy
headlines.summary: General Motors announced Oct. 20 its board authorized a $20B multiyear share repurchase program, a common method to raise the value of its shares.

description: General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts worldwide. It operates through GM North America, GM International, and GM Financial segments. The company markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Baojun, and Wuling brand names. In addition, it sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts through retail dealers, distributors and dealers, as well as to fleet customers, including daily rental car companies, commercial fleet customers, leasing companies, and governments. Further, the company offers various range of after-sale services through dealer network, such as maintenance, light repairs, collision repairs, vehicle accessories, and extended service warranties. Additionally, it provides automotive financing; and software-enabled services and subscriptions. General Motors Company was founded in 1908 and is based in Detroit, Michigan.
